text:
Two things before I act on the Wednesday 10:00 plan:

1. When did the office confirm that Diego's CSE451 lecture is cancelled that hour? Do you have the note or the date you heard it?
2. I do not have the schedule in front of me. Can you tell me where I keep it (a file, a page) so I can check my own Wednesday and put the meeting in properly?

I have already written to the department office to confirm the cancellation and asked Diego for his Wednesday. I will not book anything before both answer.

Status: Diego says Wednesday 10:00 is taken by his CSE451 lecture in his calendar, so I have not booked 10:00. I asked the office to confirm the cancellation in writing and asked where the official schedule is; provisional slot is Wednesday 12:30-13:00. I will confirm and then put it on both calendars.
